rules.name: Credentials Transmitted Over Unencrypted Channel
rules.description: Detects login or credential submission over HTTP instead of HTTPS exposing credentials to interception
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%authentication%' OR payload ILIKE '%cleartext-credentials%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Default Credentials Usage on Login
rules.description: Detects successful logins using common default usernames like admin, root, or test across services
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%authentication%' OR payload ILIKE '%default-credentials%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Account Lockout Mechanism Failure
rules.description: Detects more than 20 failed login attempts for a single account without lockout indicating weak lockout policy
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%authentication%' OR payload ILIKE '%lockout%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Authentication Schema Bypass Attempt
rules.description: Detects attempts to bypass authentication by accessing protected endpoints without valid session tokens
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%authentication%' OR payload ILIKE '%auth-bypass%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Weak Remember-Me Cookie Detection
rules.description: Detects authentication cookies lacking proper security attributes or containing predictable values
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%authentication%' OR payload ILIKE '%remember-me%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Browser Cache Sensitivity — Missing No-Cache Headers
rules.description: Detects responses from sensitive endpoints missing Cache-Control: no-store headers
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%authentication%' OR payload ILIKE '%browser-cache%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Weak Authentication — Basic Auth Over HTTP
rules.description: Detects HTTP Basic Authentication over unencrypted connections exposing credentials in cleartext
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%authentication%' OR payload ILIKE '%basic-auth%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: MFA Bypass or Absence for Privileged Accounts
rules.description: Detects privileged operations performed without MFA verification for accounts that require it
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%authentication%' OR payload ILIKE '%mfa%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Credential Stuffing Attack Detected
rules.description: Detects credential stuffing patterns with high volume login failures from the same source across multiple accounts
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%authentication%' OR payload ILIKE '%credential-stuffing%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: JWT Algorithm None Attack
rules.description: Detects JWT tokens with algorithm set to none or missing algorithm indicating authentication bypass attempt
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%authentication%' OR payload ILIKE '%jwt%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Directory Traversal Attack Detected
rules.description: Detects path traversal attempts using ../ sequences or encoded variants to access files outside intended directories
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%authorization%' OR payload ILIKE '%directory-traversal%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Authorization Schema Bypass via Role Manipulation
rules.description: Detects attempts to bypass authorization by manipulating role parameters in API requests
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%authorization%' OR payload ILIKE '%privilege-escalation%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR)
rules.description: Detects sequential or predictable resource ID access patterns indicating IDOR vulnerability exploitation
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%authorization%' OR payload ILIKE '%idor%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: OAuth Token Scope Escalation
rules.description: Detects OAuth token usage where requested scopes exceed granted scopes indicating authorization bypass
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%authorization%' OR payload ILIKE '%oauth%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
rules.description: Detects POST/PUT/DELETE requests missing CSRF tokens indicating potential cross-site request forgery
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%session%' OR payload ILIKE '%csrf%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Session Fixation Attack
rules.description: Detects session fixation where a pre-set session ID is accepted by the server after authentication
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%session%' OR payload ILIKE '%session-fixation%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Session Token in URL Parameters
rules.description: Detects session tokens transmitted in URL query strings exposing them to logging and Referer headers
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%session%' OR payload ILIKE '%url-token%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Concurrent Session on Different IPs
rules.description: Detects the same session token being used from different IP addresses simultaneously indicating session hijacking
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%session%' OR payload ILIKE '%session-hijacking%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: JWT Token Tampering or Forgery
rules.description: Detects JWT tokens with invalid signatures, expired timestamps, or algorithm manipulation
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%session%' OR payload ILIKE '%jwt%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Insecure Session Cookie Attributes
rules.description: Detects session cookies missing Secure, HttpOnly, or SameSite attributes
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%session%' OR payload ILIKE '%cookie%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES
